Markets.title: US stocks: S&P 500 opens muted as Middle East tensions weigh
Markets.summary: US stocks opened cautiously on Monday due to renewed US-Iran tensions, though the S&P 500 and Nasdaq climbed higher. Strong revenue forecasts from AI lab Anthropic helped support the technology sector during early trading.

Markets.title: Michael Burry revives AI warnings, Big Short investor says 'You could have heard it first'
Markets.summary: "Big Short" investor Michael Burry renewed his warnings about an artificial intelligence bubble following a report of $3 trillion in technology commitments for AI infrastructure. He argued that these massive off-balance-sheet obligations indicate excessive investment, market exuberance, and stretched valuations.

Markets.title: Dow Jones| Nasdaq | US Stock Market Today | Live: US stocks edge lower as Middle East tensions weigh on sentiment
Markets.summary: US stocks edged lower as escalating tensions in the Middle East negatively impacted market sentiment. Investors reacted cautiously to the geopolitical developments affecting the stock market today.

Markets.title: Puravankara Q1 Results: Revenue surges 63% to Rs 877 crore; PAT at Rs 25 crore
Markets.summary: Real estate developer Puravankara reported a 63% year-on-year surge in total revenue to Rs 877 crore for the first quarter of FY27. During the same period, the company achieved a 28% increase in pre-sales and returned to profitability with a profit after tax of Rs 25 crore.

Markets.title: Market opportunity for REITs and InvITs is set to increase 2-3x from the existing AUM by 2030: Report
Markets.summary: A recent Ionic Wealth report states that India's REITs and InvITs could grow two to three times their current assets under management by 2030. This expected market expansion is driven by low penetration rates across multiple infrastructure sectors.

Markets.title: India bonds sink on RBI's early close of FX swap facility
Markets.summary: Indian government bonds yielded higher on Monday after the central bank unexpectedly accelerated the deadline for a diaspora deposit swap program. This early termination followed strong foreign deposit inflows and disappointed investors concerned with domestic liquidity and borrowing costs.

Geo-Political.title: Trump says US to reduce military drills with South Korea after it stayed out of Iran war
Geo-Political.summary: President Trump announced the U.S. will reduce military drills with South Korea. He cited his strong relationship with North Korea's leader and South Korea's decision to stay out of the Iran conflict as reasons for the reduction.

Geo-Political.title: Trump envoy Kushner meets Netanyahu after Hamas talks on peace plan
Geo-Political.summary: US President Trump's son-in-law, Jared Kushner, met with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu. The meeting was held to secure Israeli support for a US-backed peace plan for Gaza following discussions with Hamas.

Geo-Political.title: Russia and Ukraine trade more deadly strikes
Geo-Political.summary: Recent strikes between Russia and Ukraine resulted in 13 reported deaths over a 24-hour period. Moscow reported nine fatalities, while Kyiv confirmed four deaths.

Geo-Political.title: Aid shortages and fears of starvation as Indonesia reels from deadly earthquake
Geo-Political.summary: An earthquake that struck Indonesia early Saturday killed 53 people and displaced thousands. The disaster has caused aid shortages and fears of starvation.

Geo-Political.title: Ebola outbreak in DR Congo becomes deadliest in its history
Geo-Political.summary: An outbreak caused by a rare species of Ebola called Bundibugyo has become the deadliest in the history of the Democratic Republic of Congo. This epidemic was already documented as the fastest-growing outbreak on record.

Geo-Political.title: Top Zambian opposition figures arrested days after presidential vote
Geo-Political.summary: Top Zambian opposition figures have been arrested just days after a presidential vote. The leading opposition candidate has dismissed allegations of a planned insurrection as total fabrications.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: An author discovered their WordPress SaaS course was recommended as the top result when asking ChatGPT for the best course on the subject. The author achieved this visibility without paying for advertising or traditional search engine optimization.

AI & Tech.summary: LimeWire is an AI content generation platform that helps users create various types of digital media. In addition to content creation, the platform offers tools for creators to share and monetize their work.

Data & Insights.title: India’s overall unemployment rate falls in July; joblessness rises in urban centres but eases in rural areas
Data & Insights.summary: India's overall unemployment rate decreased in July according to the Periodic Labour Force Survey. Joblessness increased in urban areas while it decreased in rural regions.

Data & Insights.title: Mint Explainer | Indian consumers are spending again. Can it last?
Data & Insights.summary: First-quarter economic growth in India was driven by rural demand, premium products, and quick commerce. However, higher input costs and food inflation threaten to disrupt this consumer recovery.

Data & Insights.title: Currency in circulation, ATM withdrawals, 10 countries, hinterland India… How UPI made a dent in the financial universe
Data & Insights.summary: India's UPI transaction value has surged to equal 70% of the country's total currency in circulation. This rapid financial growth is driven by widespread adoption extending far beyond major economic hubs into hinterland regions.

Data & Insights.title: India’s $20 trillion economy by 2036: The 5 growth engines that could unlock its next leap
Data & Insights.summary: An Equirus policy report states that India can reach a $20 trillion economy by 2036. This growth will be driven by five key areas: human capital, markets, services, governance, and currency.

Data & Insights.title: The week in charts: Price pressures, youth unemployment, chairman exit
Data & Insights.summary: This weekly compilation features data-based insights and easy-to-read charts on stories reported by Mint. Topics covered this week include price pressures, youth unemployment, and a chairman exit.

Data & Insights.title: India's WPI inflation cools marginally to 9.78% in July as fuel prices ease
Data & Insights.summary: India's Wholesale Price Index inflation eased slightly to 9.78% in July due to moderating fuel and power prices. During the same month, inflation rates for primary articles and manufactured products both increased compared to June.

India.title: Delhi University 2026 Election Rules: Paperless Campaign, Video Speeches, No Printed Posters
India.summary: Delhi University announced paperless election rules for 2026 that ban printed posters, vehicle rallies, and video-based campaigning. The guidelines also strictly prohibit the use of loudspeakers and animals for canvassing during the student union elections.

India.title: The Return Of Ram Madhav: What It Means For RSS-BJP Relations
India.summary: Ram Madhav has been appointed as a national vice president of the BJP. This role marks his return to the party's core organization after a six-year absence.

India.title: With 8 Leaders, UP Gets The Lion's Share In BJP's Big Revamp Under Nitin Nabin
India.summary: Uttar Pradesh received the largest share with eight leaders in the BJP's recent major organizational revamp. Nitin Nabin, who became the party's chief in December, announced these new appointments.

India.title: 3 Ex-Chief Ministers, 18 MPs, 10 Women: BJP's Power-Packed Team For 2029
India.summary: The BJP has announced a new leadership team that includes three former Chief Ministers, 18 MPs, and 10 women. This roster also features three leaders from the northeast, representing Tripura, Assam, and Nagaland.

India.title: 253 Detained In 14 States In Crackdown On ISI-Linked Network
India.summary: Indian authorities detained 253 people across 14 states in a major crackdown against a network linked to Pakistan's ISI. Union Home Minister Amit Shah described the operation as a significant success against cross-border terrorism.

India.title: 8 Pilgrims Killed In Fire At Hotel Near Tarapith Temple In Bengal's Birbhum
India.summary: A fire at a hotel near the Tarapith Temple in Bengal's Birbhum district killed eight pilgrims. The fire department's preliminary assessment indicates the blaze may have been caused by an electrical short circuit.

General.title: Parents pushed to breaking point by Child Maintenance Service, BBC told
General.summary: Mothers report struggling to force ex-partners to pay child support through the Child Maintenance Service. Meanwhile, fathers state they have been incorrectly billed thousands of pounds by the same agency.

General.title: Burnham exchanged messages with person posing as Trump's chief of staff
General.summary: Andy Burnham exchanged text messages with someone falsely posing as Donald Trump's chief of staff. Downing Street has declined to comment on this security breach, which was first reported by Politico.

General.title: Rain on way for UK with temperatures to drop to overnight lows of 3C in some places
General.summary: Following a summer of heatwaves and drought, the UK weather will become wetter and cooler this week. Temperatures are expected to drop to overnight lows of 3C in some areas.

General.title: Watch: Sprint sensation Amy Hunt takes gold number four at the European championships
General.summary: Amy Hunt won her fourth gold medal at the European Athletics Championships. She achieved this by helping Great Britain win the first-ever mixed 4x100m relay in the competition.

General.title: Post-mortems due on five boys killed in crash on wrong side of motorway that injured four in Ireland
General.summary: A car in which the five teenagers were travelling in was going the wrong way down a motorway in County Kildare.

General.title: Wildfire phone alert was 'entirely appropriate', government says
General.summary: Millions of phones across England and Wales received a severe emergency alert notification on Friday. The UK government defended the test, stating that the wildfire warning system was entirely appropriate.
